findings.title: Light theme value incorrectly changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: The original code was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light theme argument (first parameter of dark-light-choose) should preserve the original value of 30%, not change it to 70%. This will make `.topic-meta-data h5 a` significantly lighter on light themes, breaking the existing visual design.

findings.title: Light theme value incorrectly changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The original code was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light theme argument should preserve the original value of 70%, not change it to 30%. This will make `.custom-message-length` much darker on light themes, breaking the existing visual design.

findings.title: Light theme value incorrectly changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: The original code was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` for `.topic-map h3` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light theme argument should preserve the original value of 20%, not change it to 50%. This will make topic map headings significantly lighter on light themes.

findings.title: Light theme value incorrectly changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original code was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` for `.group-member-info .name` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light theme argument should preserve the original value of 30%, not change it to 50%. This changes the visual appearance of group member names on light themes.
